observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nagbibigay ng bukas na paanyaya, nagtatanong ng isang kaugnay na neutral na paglilinaw, naghihintay at tumatanggap ng pagwawasto, at ipinakukumpirma ang inayos na buod.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Gives an open invitation, asks one relevant neutral clarification, allows an answer and correction, and confirms the corrected summary.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Sa nasaksihang attempt, ipinipilit ang motibo o unang interpretasyon at hindi ipinakukumpirma ang inayos na buod.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: In an observed attempt, insists on a motive or first interpretation and does not confirm the corrected summary.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Independent na naipakita ang buong sequence, kabilang ang pagtanggap at pagkumpirma ng pagwawasto, nang walang prompt.
levels.kaya_na_en: Independently demonstrates the complete sequence, including accepting and confirming a correction, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naipakita ang sequence nang may prompt sa neutral na tanong o pagwawasto ng buod; ulitin para sa independent na demonstration.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Demonstrates the sequence with prompts for a neutral question or corrected summary; retry for independent demonstration.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Sa aktuwal na attempt, patuloy na ipinipilit ang motibo o maling buod kahit may prompt. Kung walang direktang nasaksihan, markahang not observed, hindi antas na ito.
levels.hindi_pa_en: In an actual attempt, continues to insist on a motive or incorrect summary despite prompts. If no performance was directly observed, mark not observed rather than this level.
